title: Sharp Riesz and reverse Riesz inequalities for degenerate elliptic operators of Grushin type
summary: We determine the sharp $L^p$ ranges of the Riesz transform and the reverse Riesz inequality for a class of power-degenerate elliptic operators of Grushin type. When the degenerate variable has dimension at least two, the Riesz transform is bounded throughout the reflexive range. In dimension one, a capacity-driven transition occurs: weak degeneracy produces a sharp finite upper endpoint, whereas strong degeneracy separates the two half-lines and restores the full range.
